description: devbox.json and devbox.lock are ignored because the devbox parity job (truvity/ci-workflows docs/devbox-update.md) owns them: it moves the devbox packages, the lockfile and the go directive together in one pull request, and a Renovate bump of either file alone would leave the three disagreeing.

packageRules.description: The go directive is owned by the devbox parity job (truvity/ci-workflows docs/devbox-update.md): it aligns go.mod with the Go devbox ships and the Go golangci-lint was built with, in the same pull request as devbox.lock. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree; devbox.json and devbox.lock are ignored above for the same reason.

The yarn release is owned by the devbox (its yarn writes the lockfile format the hardened install accepts): a packageManager bump to a newer yarn rewrites yarn.lock to a format the devbox's yarn refuses. It moves with devbox, never on its own.

truvity/policy's Go module and its library chart `service-lib` are the same release: the chart tests embed the module's copy of the library and the charts resolve the published archive, and a test holds the two versions equal. One pull request moves both (the chart pin, its Chart.lock and go.mod), never automerged: a contract change deserves a reader. A major version of the module is a manual import rewrite.

customManagers.description: The Go images' base, pinned by tag AND digest in the two places ko reads it: goreleaser's `kos:` block (the release) and .ko.yaml (a local `ko build`). The Dockerfiles' FROM lines need no rule: the dockerfile manager already moves a `:latest@sha256:` digest.
